description: Smooth random voltage generator: a new random value every so often, joined to the last one by a Bezier curve whose shape runs from spiked through straight to rounded

params.text: Sets how often a new value is drawn, a fraction of a hertz up to 50Hz
Attenuates the curve, 0 to 1, before the offset is added
Shapes the join between one value and the next: spiked at fully counter-clockwise, a straight line at the centre, rounded at fully clockwise
Adds a fixed voltage to the curve, -5V to 5V, which is also the point the inverted output is mirrored around
Attenuates and inverts the FM jack, -1 to 1, and multiplies it by 1.5 before it is added to the FREQ knob in octaves
Attenuates and inverts the LEVEL jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the LEVEL knob
Chooses what happens when the offset pushes the curve past 5V: CLIP holds it at the limit, FOLD turns it back from there, WRAP jumps it to the opposite limit

inputs.text: Replaces the random draw with whatever is patched here, sampled at the moment each new value is due, so the module becomes a sample and hold with a curved slew
Divided into octaves by the attenuverter and added to the FREQ knob; by default it is sampled only when a new value is drawn
Divided by 5, clamped to -2 and 2, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the LEVEL knob; by default it is sampled only when a new value is drawn

outputs.text: The curve, 0V to 5V either side of the offset, limited in the way the switch sets
The curve subtracted from the offset rather than added to it, limited in the way the switch sets
A 10V pulse 1 millisecond long each time a new random value is drawn
10V while the curve is above the offset and 0V while it is below it

notes: the rate cannot be synchronised to an outside clock; the FREQ knob and its jack are the only way to set it
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Continuous Frequency Modulation — reads the FM jack every sample instead of only when a new value is drawn
Continuous Level Modulation — reads the LEVEL jack every sample instead of only when a new value is drawn, and applies it after the curve rather than before
Assymetric Curve — makes the join start smooth and end spiked, or the other way about, instead of being the same at both ends
Distribution: Uniform, Normal — chooses between any value being equally likely and values near the middle being more likely
Post-Modulation Level Clip: 0..100%, 0..200%, -100..100%, -200..200% — sets how far the LEVEL jack may take the level past the knob's own range

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads a new random value.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
